messages:
Noah: Quick notes from the design sync re: Credentials list density + revoke/rotate interactions. Two asks: make dense rows readable at tablet widths, and ensure revoke/undo is accessible and discoverable.

Ivy: Agreed. On 800px the row wraps and the kebab shifts down. Proposal: hide secondary meta (created-by, date) under 820px and show only name + icons. Keep copy-to-clipboard visible.

Cam: Keyboard order bug: after checkbox the focus jumps to the copy button, then elsewhere. Desired: checkbox -> name -> actions -> copy -> reveal secret. Inline reveal should not break linear nav.

Taylor: Revoke modal copy suggestion:
```
Title: Revoke API key
Body: Revoking immediately disables this key. You can undo for 10 seconds.
Primary: Revoke key
Secondary: Cancel
```
Also make the warning text larger/bolder to meet 4.5:1 contrast.

Marisol: UX polish: add a subtle 1px separator between content and actions, color #E6E9EE. Increase icon hit area to 32px. For mobile, collapse labels and rely on aria-labels for icons.

Ivy: Undo toast should expose a focusable "Undo" button and update an aria-live region: "Credential revoked. Undo available." Screen reader users should get parity.

Noah: Backend note from platform: we can implement a soft-delete flag for 10s to support undo, but need a migration for audit entries if we change semantics. Will coordinate with security.

Cam: Small CSS tweak: dense row vertical padding 10px -> 12px reduces visual noise. Also add a subtle hover for the kebab so it's easier to target.

a11y-bot: Lint: potential contrast failure on revoke modal footer (rule A11Y:CONTRAST). Recommend updating color tokens.

Noah: I'll update Figma and create two tickets: "dense credential rows + keyboard order" and "revoke/rotate copy + undo a11y". @Marisol can you estimate UI effort?

Marisol: Yep, will estimate EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
